orientation.rowOrder: Exact decodeShrubTextureData normalMap output after its one EXR row reversal; top row first

mipRule: Float64 left-associated 2x2 component mean of prior unquantized float64 level; level 0 retains decoded HALF bits; each lower level rounds once to HALF. No feedback from HALF outputs, clamp, rescale, channel/row change, or normal renormalization.
alphaSubset: If available, exact source G scalar; level 0 alpha>=128, lower levels unquantized footprint mean>=127.5. This is a source-mask proxy, not a claim about driver-generated alpha mips or actual camera visibility.
